'''Cuale''' is the [[innkeeper]] at the [[Defender of the Dragonwall]] in [[Cairhien]].

==Appearance==
Cuale is a plump man with an unctuous manner.

==Activities==
Cuale welcomes [[Rand al'Thor]], [[Hurin]], and [[Loial]] to the Defender of the Dragonwall when the group arrives in the city. Shortly after the groups' arrival in his inn, Cuale presents Rand with invitations from three minor nobles.{{ref/book|2|25}} Each day, the invitations come from higher and higher ranked nobles, eventually culminating in invitations from [[Barthanes Damodred]] and [[Galldrian Riatin]].{{ref/book|2|27}}{{ref/book|2|30}} Cuale bemoans the loss of the Defender of the Dragonwall when it caught fire.{{ref/book|2|31}}
